prd.pr_detail_id, prd.line_no, prd.item_id, prd.snap_item_name as item_name, prd.snap_kind as kind, prd.snap_unit_name as unit_name, prd.snap_supplier_name as supplier_name, prd.snap_unit_price as price, prd.quantity, prd.subtotal_excluding_tax
